product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to match professionals with paid expert calls, research, advisory and employment opportunities, while helping investors, consultancies, enterprises and AI labs find relevant expertise.

pricing_page.notes: Ethos Evals has public usage-based pricing; this is not a published price list for its expert-network service.

employee_band.notes: Published team-size figures conflict or do not fit the permitted bands precisely; no requested band could be established without guessing.

eng_blog.notes: No company blog index or engineering blog was located; public product pages and social posts do not establish an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public Ethos Evals developer documentation includes MCP setup, tool reference, benchmark catalogue and billing guidance; legal pages were not counted as product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The direct-company AI Engineer and RL Engineer postings are closed; the readable direct-company openings reviewed are compliance roles. Marketplace engagements for client AI projects are not counted as Ethos employee vacancies.

model_provider.value: Anthropic; Google Gemini; Groq; OpenAI; OpenRouter; Deepgram; ElevenLabs; Cartesia
model_provider.notes: The public subprocessor list identifies AI/language, inference, routing and speech providers; it does not map each provider to a specific product request.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a publicly claimed compliance framework, not an independently issued certification. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are described as programmes to take from early setup to certification, so are excluded.

raised_18mo.notes: The 2026-05-06 Series A announcement falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable direct-company openings reviewed are compliance roles, not SDR/BDR/AE positions. The platform also lists account-executive expert engagements for external AI-research clients; those are not internal Ethos sales vacancies.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest dated launch-type item located is voice-agent v2 on 2026-03-23, before 2026-05-09. The later readable company posts concern funding and payouts. Ethos Evals is live but its public pages have no verified launch date, so it cannot establish a launch inside the window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, checkable leadership/team roster was located. The founders’ profiles predate the window, but that does not establish the absence of other C-level or VP arrivals or departures.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are disclosed sales-intelligence, lead-generation and email-discovery/verification systems. No specific CRM was publicly verified.
